summary.plain: A particle detector at SLAC built around the collision point of the PEP-II accelerator, layered so that it can pinpoint exactly where a B meson decayed and identify the particles it decayed into.
summary.technical: General-purpose PEP-II detector: multi-layer silicon vertex tracker inside a cylindrical wire drift chamber, a DIRC ring-imaging Cherenkov particle-identification detector, a CsI crystal electromagnetic calorimeter inside a superconducting solenoid, and resistive-plate-chamber muon/neutral-hadron detectors in the magnet's steel flux return.

technology.quote: Charged particle tracks are measured in a multi-layer silicon vertex tracker surrounded by a cylindrical wire drift chamber. Electromagentic showers from electrons and photons are detected in an array of CsI crystals located just inside the solenoidal coil of a superconducting magnet.
technology.value: Multi-layer silicon vertex tracker, cylindrical drift chamber, DIRC Cherenkov particle-ID detector, CsI electromagnetic calorimeter and resistive-plate-chamber muon system
